description: One meeting of the Georgia House or Senate (a floor session, a standing committee, or the Rules Committee) by its address (2026-02-05/house-rules), the General Assembly's video id or URL, or a body and a date (House Rules 2/5/2026), as the same Markdown twin the site serves: frontmatter (cite_as, canonical_url, source_url = the video), the machine-transcript notice, the summary and the bill discussions Georgia Commons wrote (one heading per bill, each with its moment in the video and the official record that confirms it), the bills read aloud, then the timestamped transcript. Speakers are not identified. A long transcript is also served in parts: `start` gives one part, as the frontmatter's `parts` list says.
name: meetings_lookup
